children: Changing jobs is becoming rewarding again, according to an analysis from Bank of America. According to BofA's account pay data, pay increases associated with changing jobs reached the highest level in more than three years in July, while the annual average job switching premium has begun to edge higher after several years of decline. Across generations, Gen Z has continued to see the greatest pay bumps from switching jobs. "Younger workers generally begin their careers at lower wage levels, creating more opportunities for substantial percentage increases when they switch jobs," the note says. (jessica.coacci@wsj.com)
